paper-0.$description:
Req for: backgrounds, inverted text
Ground: the neutral's highlighter-26 clears it as AA large text and UI elements; its pencil-47, pen-58, pen-70 and pen-100 clear it as AA standard body text; as text, AA standard body text on every family's pencil-47
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray)

paper-1.$description:
Req for: backgrounds, inverted text
Ground: highlighter-26 clears it as AA large text and UI elements; pencil-47, pen-58, pen-70 and pen-100 clear it as AA standard body text, from every family
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray)

paper-3.$description:
Req for: backgrounds, inverted text
Ground: highlighter-26 clears it as AA large text and UI elements; pencil-47, pen-58, pen-70 and pen-100 clear it as AA standard body text, from every family
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray)

paper-5.$description:
Req for: backgrounds, inverted text
Ground: highlighter-26 clears it as AA large text and UI elements; pencil-47, pen-58, pen-70 and pen-100 clear it as AA standard body text, from every family; the ground the text stops are solved against
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray). Worst background text stops must clear.

chalk-8.$description:
Req for: decorative borders, inverted text, illos, signal hierarchy
Ground: pen-58, pen-70 and pen-100 clear it as AA standard body text, from every family; the highlighter and the pencil are not held against it
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray)

chalk-11.$description:
Req for: decorative borders, inverted text, illos, signal hierarchy
Ground: pen-58, pen-70 and pen-100 clear it as AA standard body text, from every family; the highlighter and the pencil are not held against it
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray)

chalk-15.$description:
Req for: decorative borders, inverted text, illos, signal hierarchy
Ground: pen-58, pen-70 and pen-100 clear it as AA standard body text, from every family; the highlighter and the pencil are not held against it
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray)

chalk-20.$description:
Req for: decorative borders, inverted text, illos, signal hierarchy
Ground: pen-58, pen-70 and pen-100 clear it as AA standard body text, from every family; the highlighter and the pencil are not held against it
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray)

highlighter-26.$description:
Req for: focus rings, icons, large text, translucent state layers over any ground
AA large text and UI elements on every paper of every family
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray); re-solved to clear its floor

pencil-47.$description:
Req for: regular text, inverted backgrounds
AA standard body text on every paper of every family
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray); re-solved to clear its floor

pen-58.$description:
Req for: regular text, inverted backgrounds
AA standard body text on every paper and chalk of every family
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray); re-solved to clear its floor

pen-70.$description:
Req for: heavy-emphasis text, inverted backgrounds
AA standard body text on every paper and chalk of every family
Theming: tints carry neutral hue (gray); re-solved to clear its floor

pen-100.$description:
Req for: max-emphasis text
AA standard body text on every paper and chalk of every family

fill.$description:
Req for: CTAs
Use: primary button fills; optional for avatars, badges and other elements that carry text. Not a standalone color: it has no contrast guarantee of its own, only its on-text has one. Use it alone or with its hover and pressed states. Always bordered with its edge
Theming: fully re-solved per theme and family (gray)

fill-hover.$description:
Req for: CTA pointer-over state
Use: the pointer-over state of the fill, with the fill; for nothing else. Always bordered with the edge
Theming: follows its rest fill (gray)

fill-pressed.$description:
Req for: CTA pressed state
Use: the pressed state of the fill, with the fill; for nothing else. Always bordered with the edge
Theming: follows its rest fill (gray)

edge.$description:
Req for: min APCA visibility
Use: the border of the fill and its states, always rendered with them and never without them (it resolves to transparent unless the fill sits close to the page); for nothing else
Theming: draws for CTAs that sit close to the page; strength per family tier (gray)

on.$description:
Req for: text over the CTA color
AA standard body text over its CTA
Use: the only text color over the fill; never elsewhere
Theming: whichever pole passes; quiet CTAs take the soft pole (gray)

Use: the pressed state of the fill, with the fill; for nothing else. Always bordered with the edge
Theming: follows its rest fill (blue)

edge.$description:
Req for: min APCA visibility
Use: the border of the fill and its states, always rendered with them and never without them (it resolves to transparent unless the fill sits close to the page); for nothing else
Theming: draws for CTAs that sit close to the page; strength per family tier (blue)

on.$description:
Req for: text over the CTA color
AA standard body text over its CTA
Use: the only text color over the fill; never elsewhere
Theming: whichever pole passes; quiet CTAs take the soft pole (blue)

enabled.$description:
Req for: links
AA standard body text on every paper of the neutral
Use: hyperlinks; not a text-style CTA, which is the text stops read as states
Theming: rides the theme’s link color; custom seed re-solves; overridable per theme

hover.$description:
Req for: links pointer-over
AA standard body text on every paper of the neutral
Use: hyperlinks; not a text-style CTA, which is the text stops read as states
Theming: rides the theme’s link color; custom seed re-solves; overridable per theme

pressed.$description:
Req for: links pressed
AA standard body text on every paper of the neutral
Use: hyperlinks; not a text-style CTA, which is the text stops read as states
Theming: rides the theme’s link color; custom seed re-solves; overridable per theme

enabled.$description:
Req for: links over inverted backgrounds
AA standard body text on any family's pen-70
Use: hyperlinks on a pen-70 ground; not a text-style CTA
Theming: same seed as the link, re-solved for inverted backgrounds; overridable per theme

hover.$description:
Req for: links over inverted backgrounds pointer-over
AA standard body text on any family's pen-70
Use: hyperlinks on a pen-70 ground; not a text-style CTA
Theming: same seed as the link, re-solved for inverted backgrounds; overridable per theme

pressed.$description:
Req for: links over inverted backgrounds pressed
AA standard body text on any family's pen-70
Use: hyperlinks on a pen-70 ground; not a text-style CTA
Theming: same seed as the link, re-solved for inverted backgrounds; overridable per theme

brand.$description:
Req for: identity seed reference
Use: a reference value (logos, swatches of the input); never a UI color, it carries no contrast guarantee
Theming: the theme’s own input, as given

brand-alt.$description:
Req for: identity seed reference
Use: a reference value (logos, swatches of the input); never a UI color, it carries no contrast guarantee
Theming: the theme’s paired input, as given
